candidates.evidence_summary: KEYENCE's FY2025 first-half financial-results materials disclose actual USD/JPY and EUR/JPY rates, quantify the foreign-exchange impact on sales and operating income, and quantify operating-income sensitivity to both USD and EUR moves, directly documenting multi-currency FX exposure that includes both currencies represented by the Phase-8F EUR/USD factor.

FANUC's July 2026 financial-results materials report actual and forecast Yen/USD and Yen/EUR exchange rates, while the issuer's FY2025 results identify foreign-exchange fluctuations as an operating uncertainty, directly documenting concurrent USD- and EUR-linked FX exposure.

Baidu's 2025 Form 20-F reports RMB90.7 billion of short-term investments plus substantial long-term investments and time deposits, alongside outstanding interest-bearing loans; the filing documents these interest-earning and borrowing positions as material balance-sheet items, supporting a conservative documented rates-policy relationship without assigning direction or magnitude.

Datavault AI's 2025 Form 10-K states that elevated interest rates may dampen economic growth and cause companies to moderate information-technology spending, which could negatively affect demand for its products and solutions, directly documenting a rates-linked revenue-demand channel.

JD.com's 2025 Form 20-F states that JD Property drew RMB8.286 billion under a term loan priced at 65 basis points below the Loan Prime Rate with scheduled repayments through December 2028, directly documenting ongoing benchmark-linked financing sensitivity.
